summary: This Standards Track document defines three hybrid key agreement mechanisms for TLS 1.3: X25519MLKEM768, SecP256r1MLKEM768, and SecP384r1MLKEM1024. They combine post-quantum ML-KEM with an elliptic curve Diffie-Hellman exchange.

eli5.summary: Two locks work together on a door, one old and one new, so the door stays shut unless both are broken.
